name: SISO Evidence Engines
summary: A Research package family for source-grounded knowledge items, credibility-ranked engineering principles, and evidence-gated improvement ideas.

evidence.summary: Canonical public source includes the generated repository header plus the Knowledge, Principles, and Idea engine contracts, machine registry, CLI, synthetic fixtures, and corpus-exclusion checks; system tests passed.

license.reason: The clean SISO-owned engine implementation carries MIT; ingested sources and external corpora retain their own rights.

evidence.summary: Reusable code, excluded corpora, machine configuration, provider adapters, and source-rights boundaries are recorded at the pinned release.

relationships.context: Foundry discovers and prepares explicit sources; Evidence Engines turns those sources into grounded knowledge, principles, and ranked ideas without owning acquisition or corpora.

evidence.summary: The public architecture assigns acquisition, scraping, provider execution, schedulers, and corpora to Foundry or external adapters.

Knowledge value-item schema, quote grounding, credibility tiers, principle and idea gates, jury aggregation, deterministic scores, generated corpora, provider code, and mutation loops were read before classification.

Grounded and rejected knowledge, backed and unbacked principles, canonical graduation, backed and unbacked ideas, queued graduation, corpus non-retention, full CLI flow, and publication checks passed; checkpoint rated 94/100.
